subject: Plotting predictive posterior distributions of two inla models to visually compare predictive ability of the models

messages.author: 6778413cff3638a4
messages.subject: Plotting predictive posterior distributions of two inla models to visually compare predictive ability of the models
parts:
I have fitted two inla models. The first I used GLMM and the second I used GAMM. The dataset included NA in the outcome variable so the values will be predicted by the models. I already have fitted values (posterior predictive distribution) for each model.


set.seed(123)
library(INLA)
GLMMfitformula<-MP~factor(UD_1)+factor(UD_2)+factor(UV_1)+factor(UV_2)+factor(UTT_2)+factor(UTT_1)+factor(PMB_1)+factor(TMFP_1)+factor(TMHS_1)+factor(TMHS_2)+factor(TMPMB_2)+factor(TMPMB_3)+factor(TMSW_1)+factor(TAFWC_1)+factor(TPAV_2)+factor(TPAD_2)+factor(TPATT_2)+TCF+AO+TCV+NC+TCL+TCW+f(year, model="iid")+f(ID,model="iid")
GLMMpred<-inla(formula=GLMMfitformula,family="gamma", data=INLApredset,control.compute=list(dic=TRUE,mlik=TRUE,cpo=TRUE,waic=TRUE,return.marginals.predictor=TRUE), list(link=1,compute=T))


set.seed(1234)
library(INLA)
GAMMfitformula<-MP~factor(UD_1)+factor(UD_2)+factor(UV_1)+factor(UV_2)+factor(UTT_2)+factor(UTT_1)+factor(PMB_1)+factor(TMFP_1)+factor(TMHS_1)+factor(TMHS_2)+factor(TMPMB_2)+factor(TMPMB_3)+factor(TMSW_1)+factor(TAFWC_1)+factor(TPAV_2)+factor(TPAD_2)+factor(TPATT_2)+f(AO)+f(TCV)+f(NC)+f(TCL)+f(TCW)+f(year)+f(ID)
GAMMpred<-inla(formula=GAMMfitformula,family="gamma", data=INLApredset,control.compute=list(dic=TRUE,mlik=TRUE,cpo=TRUE,waic=TRUE, return.marginals.predictor=TRUE), control.predictor=list(link=1,compute=T),verbose=TRUE)
summary(GAMMpred)


I wish to plot posterior predictive distributions of model 1, model 2 and actual values in the same graph so as to compare predictive ability of the two models to the unseen dataset. Can you kincly assist me with command. 

In attempt to get such a graph, I plotted the graph using below commands, I didn't get what I wanted but I also failed to interpret the graph obtained. Any assistance will be appreciated.

library(INLAutils)
plot_inla_residuals(GLMMpred,imp1dummytest$MP)
plot_inla_residuals(GAMMpred,imp1dummytest$MP)

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Plotting predictive posterior distributions of two inla models to visually compare predictive ability of the models
parts:
easiest is to use posterior.sample, like this

## compute predictive data distributions

n <- 20
x <- rnorm(n)
eta <- 1 + 0.2 * x
y <- rpois(n, exp(eta))
y[n] <- NA

r <- inla(y ~ 1 + x,
data = data.frame(y, x),
family = "poisson",
control.compute = list(config = TRUE),
control.predictor = list(link = 1))

xx <- inla.posterior.sample(1000, r)
y.pred.fun <- function(idx) {
rpois(length(Predictor[idx]), exp(Predictor[idx]))
}

yy <- inla.posterior.sample.eval(y.pred.fun, xx, idx = which(is.na(y)))
hist(unlist(yy), prob = TRUE)




by letting 'idx' be a vector you can do many at the same time., then the
output is a matrix, and you can just do the hist of each row (I think)

see the vignette about inla.posterior.sample.eval
